title: Create src/search-preflight.js

promptContext.rawText: Create a new file src/search-preflight.js exporting one function searchPreflight(pipelineDir). It requires fs, path, inboxDir from ./side-finding.js, and normalizeTokens from ./text-similarity.js. Step 1: resolve dir = inboxDir(pipelineDir) and try fs.readdirSync(dir) in a try/catch; on any error return { ok:false, reason:'inbox-unreachable' }. Step 2: filter names to .json, cap at Number(process.env.AGENT_MANAGER_SIDE_FINDING_SWEEP_BATCH)||50, and for each attempt JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync); if the record has truthy .title and .body, run normalizeTokens(title+' '+body) and if the Set.size>0 return { ok:true, sample:{ title, tokenCount:set.size } }. Step 3: if no item passed, return { ok:false, reason:'no-parseable-results' }. Deterministic, no network, no LLM. Verify with node -e "require('./src/search-preflight.js')".
